theater: 河北廣宗、下曲陽與中原汝南

battle.name: 黃巾之亂
battle.theater: 河北廣宗、下曲陽與中原汝南
battle.brief: 中平元年二月，太平道首領張角以「蒼天已死，黃天當立，歲在甲子，天下大吉」號召八方同時起事，旬日天下響應，京師震動。帝遣盧植、皇甫嵩、朱儁分道進剿，經汝南長社夜火、廣宗破城、下曲陽攻堅，平定主力。卡面亞述長矛為西亞短柄長刃刺兵，映照漢軍環首刀、戟密集列陣的步戰裝備。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰方分為起事與平叛兩大陣營。起事一方是太平道：鉅鹿人張角自稱「天公將軍」，弟張寶、張梁分稱「地公將軍」「人公將軍」；道眾按地域編為三十六方，各置渠帥，渠帥之下設祭酒，掌傳教與勸化之職。中平元年先起八方，即汝南、潁川、陳留、南陽、冀州、燕國、下曲陽、幽州，汝南與潁川由波才率領，南陽由張曼成率領，冀州與下曲陽由張寶、褚飛率領，燕國由張牛率領，各方兵眾以萬計，盔甲器械多取自民間農具改製。官軍一方由中央集兵與州郡地方兵力組成：朝廷以三公將軍出討，北中郎將盧植赴冀州圍廣宗，左中郎將皇甫嵩將兵平汝南、潁川，右中郎將朱儁赴南陽、陳留，京師宿衛虎賁、羽林及北軍五校亦隨軍出動；地方上各州刺史、太守、郡兵及募自鄉里的義勇分擔封堵與追剿，幽州刺史公孫瓚、荊州刺史劉表、豫州刺史孔伷、徐州刺史陶謙、河內太守王匡各領本部防範。曹操時為騎都尉，率己吾募兵五千擊破陳留一帶黃巾餘部；劉備隨公孫瓚參與冀州戰事，論功得任平原相。
countriesEn: The opposing sides fall into a rebel camp and a suppression camp. The insurgents were the Taiping Dao, the Way of Great Peace: Zhang Jue of Julu styled himself 'General of the Heavenly Duke', while his younger brothers Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang took the titles 'General of the Earth Duke' and 'General of the Human Duke'. The adherents were organised geographically into thirty-six divisions, each with a qushuai as division commander, and beneath them stood jijiu, officers charged with propagation and instruction. In the first year of Zhongping eight divisions rose at once: Runan, Yingchuan, Chenliu, Nanyang, Jizhou, Yan, Xiaquyang and Youzhou. Bo Cai led Runan and Yingchuan, Zhang Mancheng led Nanyang, Zhang Bao and Chu Fei led Jizhou and Xiaquyang, Zhang Niu led Yan, and every division counted several thousand men whose armour and weapons were largely converted from farm tools. The government side combined centrally raised troops with contingents raised locally. The court dispatched the three generals of the Three Excellencies: Bei Zhonglang Jiang Lu Zhi went north to invest Julu and besiege Guangzong, Zuo Zhonglang Jiang Huangfu Song marched against Runan and Yingchuan, and You Zhonglang Jiang Zhu Jun operated in Nanyang and Chenliu; the Tiger Guard, the Feather Guard and the five schools of the Northern Army moved out with the host as well. At local level, provincial inspectors, commandery administrators, commandery levies and village militias raised on the spot shared the tasks of containing the rising and pursuing the rebels. Gongsun Zan in Youzhou, Liu Biao in Jingzhou, Kong Fu in Yuzhou, Tao Qian in Xu and Wang Kuang in Henei each guarded their own districts. Cao Cao, then a cavalry commandant, led five thousand men recruited at Jiwu and broke a Yellow Turban band around Chenliu; Liu Bei served under Gongsun Zan in the fighting in Jizhou and was appointed magistrate of Pingyuan for his service.
people: 決定戰局的是幾個名字。張角以符水咒說為人治病、聚眾傳道，潛行數十年，至中平元年以「蒼天已死，黃天當立，歲在甲子，天下大吉」號召天下；舉兵之後病死於廣宗，屍首被剖棺取首，傳示各州郡。弟張寶同年十月戰歿下曲陽，張梁守廣宗至八月城破被斬，首級同樣送洛楊。張燕自常山起別動，眾至百萬，遊擊牽制官軍達十餘年，建安年間歸降曹操，被拜平北將軍、安國亭侯，部眾被分散編入郡縣屯田。官軍方面的關鍵者是盧植、皇甫嵩、朱儁：盧植以儒者領北中郎將，築圍塹、斷廣宗糧道，一度斬首萬餘級，卻因不肯賄宦官被召回，改派董卓，兵敗下獄；皇甫嵩在汝南長社初戰失利退守，後乘夜縱火大破波才，再以火攻破廣宗斬張梁，拜左車騎將軍、封陽夏亭侯；朱儁於南陽破張曼成、斬張楚，漢廷因此得以在一年之內平定主力。內廷方面，竇武企圖借平叛之機誅宦官，事敗被殺，黨錮之風自此再起；中常侍徐奉私通張角為內應，事洩後暴露，逼使起事提前倉促，役使全局失去從容部署的餘地。
peopleEn: A handful of names decided the outcome. Zhang Jue gathered followers by healing the sick with chanted water and talismans, propagating the faith in secret for years, until in the first year of Zhongping he called the realm with the words 'The Blue Heaven is dead, the Yellow Heaven shall rise, in the jiazi year all under heaven shall be blessed'. After raising his banners he fell ill and died at Guangzong; his body was opened, the head taken out, and the head sent round the provinces for all to see. His brother Zhang Bao fell in battle at Xiaquyang in the tenth month of the same year, and Zhang Liang held Guangzong until the city fell in the eighth month, when he was beheaded and his head likewise carried to Luoyang. Zhang Yan raised a separate column in Changshan with a following said to reach a million men, harrying the government forces for more than ten years; in the Jian'an era he surrendered to Cao Cao, was made General Pacifying the North and Marquis of Anguo, and his adherents were broken up and settled as colonists on the land. The decisive figures on the government side were Lu Zhi, Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun. Lu Zhi, a Confucian scholar, took command as Bei Zhonglang Jiang, built a ring of trenches, cut the grain road of Guangzong and at one point claimed more than ten thousand heads, but was recalled because he refused to bribe the eunuchs; Dong Zhuo was sent in his place and failed, ending in the prison. Huangfu Song was checked at Changshe in Runan, retired, and then let the wind carry his fire into Bo Cai's camp at night, winning a crushing victory, followed later by the burning of Guangzong and the beheading of Zhang Liang, for which he was made Left General of the Chariots and Marquis of Yangxia. Zhu Jun broke Zhang Mancheng in Nanyang and slew Zhang Chu, and the court could thus dispose of the main body of the rebels within a single year. At court, Dou Wu tried to use the suppression of the rising as a pretext to destroy the eunuchs, was defeated and killed, and the Proscription of the Partisans was renewed. A palace eunuch, Xu Feng, had been in secret communication with Zhang Jue as an insider; once this was exposed the whole rising was forced to break out prematurely, and every side of the plan was thrown into confusion.
kits: 卡面所繪是亞述長矛，前九百年的西亞制式短柄長刃刺兵，鐵鏃配束柄，與弓、盾同為亞述步兵的骨幹，靠密集隊形與近身壓制推進。東漢軍隊的步戰裝備序列與之不同：郡兵與募兵步卒以環首刀、戟、鐵矛為主，戟兼刺與鉤，適合在缺乏馬匹與重甲的鄉兵中列陣；虎賁、羽林等宿衛用矛、戟與大盾；弩機強弩與弓箭是遠程火力，起事眾軍因缺鋼鐵，兵刃多由農具、鐵器改製，長柄大刀、梃、矛為主，另有太平道以符水、印綬、經卷作結社與號令之物。攻城與野戰的器械方面，廣宗之戰黃巾用雲梯，夜襲時焚燒官軍雲車，官軍則以撞車、橦車、樓車、弩攻破城垣，並以鐵裹大車衝撞密集步陣；傳令與通信靠符信、檄文與烽火，兩軍都靠就地徵發糧秣維持，黃巾行走鄉野取食於屯聚之處，官軍糧道則屢遭張燕騎隊切斷。亞述長矛雖不見於漢代出土實物，其形制卻是歐亞大陸步戰刺兵最早成熟的一類，漢代矛、戟短柄大刃、重心靠前的取向，正可與之對看。
kitsEn: The card shows the Assyrian spear, the standard short-hafted, long-bladed thrusting arm of western Asia nine centuries before the war, an iron head fitted to a bound grip. Together with the bow and the shield it formed the backbone of Assyrian infantry, which advanced in dense formations and fought at close quarters. The equipment sequence of the Eastern Han armies was different. Levies and recruited foot of the commanderies fought with ring-pommel sabres, halberds and iron spears, the halberd serving both to thrust and to hook, a combination well suited to provincial troops short of horses and heavy armour. The Tiger Guard and the Feather Guard, the imperial household guard, used spears, halberds and large shields. Strong crossbows and bows supplied the long-range fire, while the insurgents, short of steel, converted farm tools and ironwork into weapons, favouring long-handled broadswords, staves and spears; the Taiping Dao also used chanted water, seals and ribbons and copies of the scripture as the tokens of fellowship and of orders. For siege and field work, the Yellow Turbans used scaling ladders at Guangzong and burned the government siege towers during a night raid, while the government side brought up battering rams, timber-towers, wheeled towers and crossbows against the walls and drove iron-faced waggons into the packed foot formations. Orders and messages travelled by talisman, proclamation and beacon, and both sides subsisted on grain requisitioned on the spot: the insurgents moved through the countryside and drew supplies from the villages where they massed, while the government grain roads were repeatedly cut by Zhang Yan's riders. The Assyrian spear does not appear among Han excavated finds, yet its form is one of the earliest mature thrusting arms in Eurasia, and the short haft, long blade and forward weight of the Han spear and halberd can be read against it.
tactics: 起事方採取的是多點同時發難的戰法：三十六方中先挑八方同日起事，每方渠帥率眾直撲郡縣城邑，奪取官府武庫、獄囚與糧食，並沿途裹黃巾為號，使旬日之內天下響應、京師震動；破城之後不設深固塹壕，多以流動隊伍轉戰鄉里，靠符水與同一套教令維持鬥志，遇官軍主力則聚眾夜襲，如張角在廣宗乘夜襲盧植之營、焚其雲車，一度殺死官軍大將軍陳武，隨即退保城郊。官軍則採分道進剿、逐步收網：盧植自北線築圍塹、斷廣宗糧道、逼其就範，皇甫嵩與朱儁分率兩翼在汝南、陳留、南陽掃平各路，皇甫嵩在長社先敗後勝，借東風夜縱火攻入波才營，再乘勝追擊於蔡陽；破廣宗之役則以連夜火攻、趁亂登城完成，朱儁在南陽線採正面強攻與截斷糧道並行。兵種運用上，官軍大量使用騎兵巡邏與斷糧、投射攻城器械，並以大車衝撞密集步陣，正是針對起事眾缺乏騎兵與攻城器械的弱點；後段平定張燕部眾時，則改以分道招撫、編入郡縣屯田為主的柔性手段。
tacticsEn: The insurgents adopted a plan of simultaneous outbreaks at many points. Eight of the thirty-six divisions rose on the same day, each qushuai leading his men straight at the commandery and county seats, seizing the government arsenals, the gaol and the grain, and marking the way with yellow turbans, so that within ten days the whole realm answered and the capital shook. Once a city fell they built no deep earthworks, but moved in fluid columns through the countryside, holding the ranks together with the chanted water and a single set of teaching formulas; when they met a government main force they massed for a night attack, as when Zhang Jue fell on Lu Zhi's camp by night at Guangzong, burned his siege towers and for a time killed the government general Chen Wu before falling back towards the city. The government side fought by advancing along separate axes and closing the net step by step. Lu Zhi came down from the north, ringed Guangzong with trenches, cut its grain road and pressed the rebels into a corner, while Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun swept the Runan, Chenliu and Nanyang lines with their two wings. At Changshe Huangfu Song was beaten first and then won, letting the east wind carry his fire into Bo Cai's camp at night and following the broken enemy as far as Caiyang. The reduction of Guangzong was completed by a night fire and an assault carried up through the confusion, and on the Nanyang axis Zhu Jun combined frontal assault with the cutting of the grain road. In the use of arms, the government relied heavily on cavalry for patrol and for cutting supplies, on siege engines for the walls, and on iron-faced waggons sent against packed foot, exactly against the insurgents' weakness in cavalry and siege equipment. In the later phase, when Zhang Yan's followers were being settled, the government switched to softer methods, seeking separate surrender and absorbing the men into the commandery settlements for land reclamation.
data: 可考的數字大致如下。太平道在起事前已傳道二十餘年，徒眾號稱數十萬，分布八州；起事之眾分編三十六方，先動八方，每方兵眾以萬計。起事之後旬日之內天下響應、京師震動，朝廷被迫下詔徵發天下精兵與募兵討伐。戰果方面：盧植在廣宗攻破張角大營，斬首萬餘級，並築圍塹斷其糧道，迫使起事軍收縮；皇甫嵩長社一戰破波才，斬首萬餘級，繼而追擊至蔡陽再破之；同年八月破廣宗，斬張梁，首級傳送洛陽，張角屍首遭剖棺戮首，傳首天下；十月下曲陽之役破張寶，斬首亦達數萬級。掃尾戰線上，張燕聚眾至百萬，在常山、濟北一帶遊擊近二十年，至建安年間降曹之後，其眾被分散安置屯田。戰役本身的人命與物資損耗，在官方文獻中缺乏完整統計，只能知道朝廷前後徵發的兵員與糧秣數量巨大，地方州郡為供應軍需而層層加派，可見這場戰爭對編戶齊民與財政的消耗極為沉重。
dataEn: The figures that can be established are roughly as follows. The Taiping Dao had been preaching for more than twenty years before the rising, and its adherents were said to number several hundred thousand, spread across eight provinces. The insurgents were organised into thirty-six divisions, of which eight moved first, each division numbering several thousand men. Within ten days of the outbreak the whole realm answered and the capital was shaken, and the court was forced to issue an edict calling out the picked troops of the whole empire together with newly recruited men. As to results: Lu Zhi broke Zhang Jue's great camp at Guangzong, claiming more than ten thousand heads, ringed the city with trenches and cut its grain road, forcing the insurgents to contract; at Changshe Huangfu Song broke Bo Cai for more than ten thousand heads and then pursued them to Caiyang and broke them again; in the eighth month of the same year Guangzong fell, Zhang Liang was beheaded and his head sent to Luoyang, while Zhang Jue's corpse was opened, the head cut off and sent round the realm; in the tenth month Xiaquyang fell and Zhang Bao was slain, again with tens of thousands of heads taken. On the mopping-up front Zhang Yan massed as many as a hundred thousand men and harried the government for nearly twenty years across Changshan and Jibei, and after his surrender in the Jian'an era his followers were dispersed and settled as colonists on reclaimed land. Complete statistics for the casualties and material losses of the war itself do not survive in the official record; what is known is that the numbers of troops and grain requisitioned were enormous, that the commanderies levied supplies repeatedly on the provinces, and that the war weighed heavily on registered households and on state finance.
cause: 起義的直接原因是社會結構失衡。東漢末年豪強地主兼併土地，依附於田莊的佃客與部曲不登戶籍，國家編戶大量流失，租調與力役全數壓在失去土地的農民身上；連年水旱、蝗災與疫癘流行，饑民遍野，而官府救荒不力。政治上，靈帝朝宦官與外戚交替把持朝柄，黨錮餘波使士人長期受禁，仕途斷絕，太平道以符水治病、勸善誡惡的方式在民間聚合，正好承接了這份不滿。《太平經》又有「蒼天已死，黃天當立，歲在甲子，天下大吉」的讖語，張角據此推算甲子歲為更替之年，上一次甲子歲起事未成，此次再試。起事原定有從容布置的時間表，並派弟子往各州郡聯絡，卻因中常侍徐奉私通張角事洩、內應者被官軍捕獲，首領被迫提前發難，許多方帥尚未集結便暴露了全盤計劃，倉促之下留下大量可乘之機。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the rising was a social structure out of balance. In the late Eastern Han the great landowners were swallowing up estates; tenants and household retainers attached to those estates were not entered in the registers, so the state's registered households drained away and the land tax and the corvée fell entirely on peasants who had lost their land. Drought, flood, locusts and epidemics came year after year, famine spread across the countryside, and the authorities were slow to give relief. In politics the eunuchs and the consort clans held the court in turn, and the lingering shadow of the Proscription kept scholars shut out of office for years, so that the Taiping Dao, which healed with chanted water and preached good and warned against evil, gathered the countryside's discontent along exactly that seam. The scripture itself carried the words 'The Blue Heaven is dead, the Yellow Heaven shall rise, in the jiazi year all under heaven shall be blessed', and Zhang Jue reasoned from them that a jiazi year was a year of change; the attempt of the previous jiazi year had failed, so he would try again. The rising had been planned with time to spare and with disciples sent out to every commandery to make contact, but because a palace eunuch, Xu Feng, had been in secret correspondence with Zhang Jue and the insiders were rounded up by the authorities, the leaders were forced to strike early. Many division commanders had not yet gathered, yet the whole plan was already exposed, and the haste left a great many openings for the government to exploit.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了東漢的權力結構。平叛耗空了中央的兵員與府庫，朝廷不得不把兵權與財權下放到州郡，州刺史由中央官員變為掌兵、掌資源的地方大員，州牧一職在平亂中被推到前台，漢室的行政與財政單位實際下沉，後來袁術、劉表、曹操、劉備各據一方、以州郡為基業的格局由此起頭。中央的崩解同時把宦官與外戚推入互相消耗的循環：竇武借平叛誅宦官不成而死，黨錮再起；何進掌兵後召外戚入宮，謀殺宦官反被殺；董卓趁亂入洛陽、廢立天子，終致遷都長安，東漢名存實亡的過程由此加速。經濟上，戰亂與流亡重創編戶，豪強田莊趁機吸併土地與流民，租佃關係與莊園經營在中原與江南進一步發展。思想上，太平道顯示了民間宗教的組織能力；張角之後，張魯在漢中以五斗米道立國割據近三十年，張燕部眾降曹後被整編屯田，民間結社與教派從此成為王朝無法忽視的政治力量。
impactEn: The war changed the structure of Eastern Han power. Suppressing the rising drained the central armies and the treasury, and the court had to push military and fiscal authority down into the provinces. Inspectors turned from officers of the centre into great local powers with troops and resources in their hands, and the office of provincial governor was pushed to the front of the stage by the need to end the rebellion; the administrative and financial units of the Han state in effect sank to regional level, and the pattern by which Yuan Shu, Liu Biao, Cao Cao and Liu Bei each built a power base on their own commandery dates from this. The breakdown of the centre at the same time threw eunuchs and consort clans into a cycle of mutual destruction: Dou Wu used the suppression as a pretext to remove the eunuchs, failed and was killed, and the Proscription was renewed; He Jin took command of the troops, called in the consort kinsmen, and was murdered when he plotted against the eunuchs; Dong Zhuo entered Luoyang amid the confusion, deposed and enthroned emperors, and finally carried the capital away to Chang'an, accelerating the point at which the Eastern Han existed in name alone. Economically, war and flight gutted the registered households, and the great estates absorbed land and refugees, so that tenancy and estate management advanced further in the central plain and the south. In thought, the Taiping Dao demonstrated the organising power of popular religion; after Zhang Jue, Zhang Lu founded a state in Hanzhong on the Five Pecks of Rice and held it for nearly thirty years, and Zhang Yan's followers were reorganised into land-settlement colonies after their surrender, so that popular associations and teachings became a political force no dynasty could ignore.
result: 中平元年之內，起事主力被平定。張角病死廣宗，張梁於八月城破被斬，張寶十月戰歿下曲陽，首級與屍首分別傳送洛陽與諸州郡，剖棺戮尸之外，官軍在各地築京觀以示威。皇甫嵩因功拜左車騎將軍、封陽夏亭侯，盧植、朱儁亦得賞賜。然而勝利並不等於平亂：主力既破，殘部轉為流動的盜賊與流民，張燕率領的百萬眾在常山、濟北、陳留一帶繼續遊擊近二十年，朝廷主力被牽制，無力解決地方治理與糧秣供應的根本問題。官軍對殘部的最終處理是招撫為主：張燕歸降後被授平北將軍、安國亭侯，部眾編入郡縣屯田，多數人重新落地為編戶。這場戰爭的結果因此是雙重的：叛亂的首領與主力被消滅，漢室的中央權威卻再無力恢復，國家機器轉而倚賴州郡與地方豪強，東漢的崩解進入了不可逆的階段。
resultEn: Within the first year of Zhongping the main body of the rising was destroyed. Zhang Jue died of illness at Guangzong, Zhang Liang was beheaded when the city fell in the eighth month, and Zhang Bao was killed at Xiaquyang in the tenth month; the heads and the corpse were carried separately to Luoyang and to the various provinces and commanderies, and beyond the opening of the coffin and the parading of the head, the government raised mounds of the collected heads in various places to show its hand. Huangfu Song was made Left General of the Chariots and Marquis of Yangxia for his service, and Lu Zhi and Zhu Jun were rewarded in turn. Victory however was not the same as peace. With the main body broken, the remnants turned into roving bands of thieves and refugees, and the following of a hundred thousand led by Zhang Yan went on harrying the country for nearly twenty years around Changshan, Jibei and Chenliu, tying down the government armies and leaving it unable to solve the underlying problems of local administration and supply. The final handling of the remnants was chiefly by inducement: after Zhang Yan surrendered he was made General Pacifying the North and Marquis of Anguo, and his men were enrolled in the commanderies and settled as colonists on reclaimed land, most of them returned to the soil as registered households. The result of the war is therefore twofold. The leaders and the main body of the rebellion were destroyed, yet the central authority of the Han could never be restored; the state machine came to lean on the commanderies and the local great families, and the disintegration of the Eastern Han entered a stage from which it could not return.
